welcome.tagline: Read the real books you own, a little every day
welcome.pickRoom: Choose a room for your shelf
welcome.pickRoomHint: You can change it any time in Settings
welcome.firstBookHint: The one you most want to read right now. Add the rest later.
welcome.goal: How long do you want to read each day?
welcome.goalHint: A day counts as a reading day when you reach this. Starting small works best.
welcome.readyBody: Try 5 minutes now? You can stop any time.
welcome.readyNoBook: Add your first book with the + button, then start reading.
welcome.restore: Moving from another device? Import a backup

shelf.pickNextBody: Tap a book on the shelf, or let the app pick one
shelf.emptyBody: Add the books you own and watch the shelf fill up

book.etaUnknown: Read a little and the app will estimate the time left
book.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{title}}" and all its reading sessions? This can't be undone.
book.whyRead: Why I want to read it
book.seriesSkipWarn: You haven't read book {{index}} before this one

fields.title: Title
fields.subtitle: Subtitle
fields.whyRead: Why I want to read it

book.needsLookup: Will look up details when online
book.missing: This book could not be found
book.offline: You are offline. Try again when connected
book.flip: Flip to see the back cover
book.reviewPlaceholder: What did you like or not like?
book.whyReadPlaceholder: e.g. I want to understand money better, or a friend said it's great

read.noBookBody: Add a book you own first, then start reading here
read.firstTime: You haven't opened this one yet. A page or two is enough to start.
read.notePlaceholder: What did you get from this session? One line is enough

quote.empty: No quotes yet. When a line stands out, photograph the page to keep it.
quote.photoHint: The app reads the text from the photo. Delete everything except the line you like.
quote.textPlaceholder: Type or paste the line you like
quote.ocrEmpty: Couldn't read text from the photo. Try a sharper photo or type it in.
quote.ocrFail: Reading the photo failed. Please try again.

add.title: Add a book
add.photoFrontHint: Lay the book flat and fit the whole cover in the photo
add.continuousHint: Shoot the next book right away. Details are guessed in the background for you to check later.
add.adjustHint: Drag the 4 points onto the cover corners and the photo is straightened
add.photoBackHint: Include the ISBN barcode for the most accurate details
add.queued: Saved. Guessing the details in the background
add.nothingFound: No details found. You can type them in
add.offlineSaved: You're offline. Details will be filled in when you're back online
add.workingHint: The first time can take a while because the Thai text reader has to load

step.ocr: Reading the text on the cover

add.searchOffline: Online search isn't available right now. You can type the details in

session.noSensor: This device can't tell when it's face down. Use pause and play instead.
session.flipToStart: Lay your phone face down to start the timer
session.flipToContinue: Lay your phone face down to keep reading
session.fiveDoneBody: Keep going or stop here. Either way, it counts.
session.discardBody: The time on the timer won't be saved
session.forgotBody: The timer has been running since {{time}}. If you didn't read that long, fix it here.

result.title: {{time}} read
result.quoteTip: Found a line you liked? Save it on the book's page.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.lead: Builds a prompt with your shelf data to paste into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini
ai.randomBody: A random pick from your unread books
ai.mineEmpty: Save prompts you use often and the app fills in your book data
ai.tplBodyHint: Tap a chip below to insert data the app fills in
ai.tplBodyPlaceholder: e.g. Summarise what I learned from {currentBook} using these notes {notes}
ai.moodLabel: What do you feel like reading?
ai.editable: You can edit it before copying
ai.copyFail: Couldn't copy. Long-press the text to copy it yourself
ai.collageHint: Attach the cover image too so the AI sees the real books. Its numbers match the list
ai.openHint: Or open an AI app with the text (it's copied too)

whatNext.name: What should I read next?
whatNext.desc: The AI weighs reviews, quality and your taste, then ranks with reasons

finishPlan.name: Plan to finish

summarizeNotes.desc: Turn your notes and quotes into key ideas

settings.title: Settings
settings.installBody: Opens like an app, starts faster and keeps your data safer
settings.installIOS: In Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen". Your data won't be cleared when you don't open it for a while
settings.qualityHint: Lower it if your phone gets warm or laggy
settings.reminderBody: The app makes a daily event in your phone's calendar. It's more reliable than web app notifications
settings.reminderSaved: Open the downloaded file to add it to your calendar
settings.dataBody: Everything is stored only on this device. Export a backup file and import it on a new device
settings.exported: Exported. Keep the file somewhere safe
settings.persisted: The browser will keep your data
settings.notPersisted: The browser may clear data if storage runs low
settings.wipe: Delete all data on this device
settings.wipeBody: All books, sessions, quotes and photos will be gone. They can only come back from a backup file
settings.about: All your data stays on your device. Nothing is sent to a server
settings.mergeBody: Keep what's on this device and add the file's data. For the same book, the most recently edited version wins
settings.replaceBody: Delete everything on this device and use the file's data instead
settings.importBad: This isn't an Ireadbook backup, or the file is damaged. Nothing was changed
settings.importNewer: This file comes from a newer app version. Update the app and try again
